text.hi: किताब का उदाहरण: The four friends pooled their money to buy bus tickets. अब सही phrase चुनो।
text.hinglish: Kitaab ka udaharan: The four friends pooled their money to buy bus tickets. Ab sahi phrase chuno.
text.en: The book's example: The four friends pooled their money to buy bus tickets. Now pick the right phrase.

steps.sentence: I have put my pen somewhere. I am not able to ___.

meaning.hi: मैंने पेन कहीं रख दिया। मैं उसे ढूँढ नहीं पा रहा/रही।
meaning.hinglish: Maine pen kahin rakh diya. Main use dhoondh nahi pa raha/rahi.

meaning.hinglish: Dasvi ke baad tum kya chunoge: Arts, Science ya Commerce?

steps.sentence: The child held his mother's hand tightly so that he may not ___.

meaning.hi: बच्चे ने माँ का हाथ कसकर पकड़ा ताकि वह खो न जाए।
meaning.hinglish: Bachche ne maa ka haath kaskar pakda taaki woh kho na jaaye.

steps.sentence: ___ the correct solution of this sum.

meaning.hi: इस सवाल का सही हल निकालो।

meaning.hi: मेले में कई मज़ेदार झूले थे।

steps.sentence: If you stand under the hot sun you will ___.

meaning.hinglish: Tez dhoop mein khade rahoge to chakkar aayenge.

steps.sentence: The principal likes to ___ the school to see all the classes.

meaning.hinglish: Principal saari classein dekhne ke liye school ka chakkar lagaana pasand karte hain.

meaning.hi: मैं तुम्हें सुन नहीं पा रहा। कृपया ज़ोर से बोलो।
